articles.summary: Appointment Enhances Board Governance of Company’s Technology Strategy and Execution, Including Transformative AI Initiatives US Foods Holding Corp. (NYSE: USFD), one of America’s largest foodservice distributors, announced today that Lisa M. Lambert has been appointed to the Board of Directors, effective Nov. 12, 2026. “Lisa brings deep expertise in large-scale technology strategy and execution, digital solutions, transformative AI and cybersecurity,” said Dave Flitman, Chair of the Board and CEO of US Foods. “Her track record of delivering strategic value in technology advancements will help accelerate our industry-leading technology roadmap aimed at deepening our differentiation, driving volume growth and improving our supply chain productivity. We look forward to the many benefits her insights and experience will provide to US Foods.” Lambert currently serves as the Founder and Chief Executive Officer of Whitestone Investors III, LLC, a venture capital firm dedicated to fueling
articles.title: US Foods Announces Appointment of Lisa M. Lambert to Board of Directors

articles.summary: Grew Net Sales 2.1% to $10.4 Billion, Net Income 42.5% to $218 Million and Diluted EPS 49.3% to $1.00 Grew Adjusted EBITDA 9.9% to $555 Million and Adjusted Diluted EPS 17.8% to $1.26 Independent Restaurant Case Growth of 5.0% Acquired Prime Line Distributors in October and Repurchased $191 Million of USFD Shares US Foods Holding Corp. (NYSE: USFD), one of the largest foodservice distributors in the United States, today announced results for the third quarter of fiscal year 2026. Third Quarter Fiscal 2026 Highlights Total case volume increased 1.3%; independent restaurant case volume increased 5.0% Net sales increased 2.1% to $10.4 billion Gross profit increased 8.6% to $1.9 billion Net income increased 42.5% to $218 million Net income margin increased 60 basis points to 2.1% Adjusted EBITDA 1 increased 9.9% to $555 million Adjusted EBITDA margin 1 increased 38 basis points to 5.3% Diluted EPS increased 49.3% to $1.00; Adjusted Diluted EPS 1 increased 17.8% to $1.26
articles.title: US Foods Reports Third Quarter Fiscal Year 2026 Earnings
